game_installed_description: Games installed through Steam, League of Legends, Riot, HoYoPlay, Epic, and WeGame. Only the launchers' records are read; your drives aren't scanned.
game_installed_empty: No games found. For games not installed through these launchers, enter the launch path in a game profile below.
game_computer_use_ask_desc: Ask once per conversation, before the first action
game_computer_use_deny_desc: Never use the mouse or keyboard in this game
game_detect_none: No installed games found. You can enter the launch path manually.
game_detect_filled: Filled in how to launch “{name}”. Remember to save.
game_console_status_failed: Couldn't read the console channel status: {error}
game_console_enabled_toast: Turned on. After starting the game, send a test message first to make sure it goes through.
game_console_disabled_toast: Turned off. The line Kotone added in the game folder and kotone_say.cfg have been removed.
game_key_capture_timeout: Key recording timed out. Try again.
game_profile_saved_merged: Profile saved. Merged {count} duplicate vocabulary entries (takes effect next time you speak).
game_profile_saved: Game profile saved (vocabulary takes effect next time you speak)
game_package_export_unsupported: dev:web can't export .zip files. Test this in the Tauri app.
game_page_description_legacy: Manage each game's chat keys, vocabulary, and how messages are sent.
game_page_description: The games installed on this PC, with a setup for each: chat keys, vocabulary, timing, and whether keys can be pressed for you.
game_profiles_description: Import a shared .zip profile package, or export your own to share.
game_package_export_title: Export as a .zip profile package (you can edit it for another game and import it again)
game_profile_reset_title: Restore default profile (restores the built-in vocabulary and icon)
game_channel_cycle_hint: Press {hotkey} to cycle (change it on the Advanced page)
game_hotwords_label: Custom vocabulary ({count}, takes effect next time you speak)
game_hotwords_placeholder:
One entry per line; duplicates are removed when you save
Example:
jungle
mid MIA
Baron Nashor
game_hotwords_help: One entry per line; duplicates are removed when you save. Importing merges (UTF-8 text in the same format; blank lines and duplicates are skipped, and the import is saved right away).
game_companion_notes_placeholder: Notes about this game, e.g. chat is in the bottom left; [Team] is your team, [All] is everyone
game_companion_notes_help: While keeping you company, she hands these notes to the AI along with the text read from chat screenshots. Put game-specific details here; no need to write rules for each game.
game_companion_notes_chat_region: Chat box position saved. You can switch back to reading the whole window in Settings → Calling her → Quick commands.
game_allow_automation_input_desc: When off, automation programs won't press keys or click the mouse in this game.
game_computer_use_help: She watches the screen while clicking and pressing keys (e.g. to find something in your inventory), and the bottom-right corner shows “Taking control · Press Esc to stop”. Press Esc (not passed to the game) or Ctrl+Shift+F12, or say “停下”, to stop her. Whether simulated clicks are safe in games with anti-cheat is your call.
game_launch_path_help: A program, shortcut, or link like steam://. Click “Auto-detect” to pick from games installed on this PC (Steam, League of Legends, Riot, HoYoPlay, Epic, WeGame). Leave it blank to find it automatically.
game_needs_admin_title: Windows will ask you to confirm when it starts
game_console_toggle: Send straight to chat without opening the chat box
game_console_toggle_desc: When you use voice input or {companion} sends a message to this game, the chat box isn't opened, and pressing keys at the same time won't interrupt it (uses the game's console commands say_team / say). Turning this on writes two things in the game folder: a key binding line at the end of autoexec.cfg in cfg (backed up to Kotone's backup folder first), and a new kotone_say.cfg. Turning it off removes both. Whether this risks a ban is your call. You can only switch it while the game is closed, and it takes effect after the game restarts. After turning it on, send a test message first to make sure it goes through.
game_console_no_install_dir: Couldn't find this game's Steam install folder (only the Steam version is supported). Messages open the chat box as usual.
game_console_running_enable: The game is running. Quit it before turning this on.
game_console_running_disable: The game is running. Quit it to turn this off.
game_console_needs_restart: The game was started before this was turned on, so it takes effect after you restart the game. Until then, messages open the chat box as usual.
game_console_key_mismatch: The key in that autoexec.cfg line was changed, so messages open the chat box as usual. Turn this off and on again to fix it.
game_chat_keys_hint: Click a key name, then press a key combination or a mouse side button. Clear it to skip that step.
game_open_chat_key_clear: Clear: don't press the open-chat key when sending
game_send_key_clear: Clear: don't press the send key when sending
game_clipboard_paste_desc: Only turn this on if the game can't receive typed text normally
game_send_timing_hint: If typing starts before the chat box opens, set “Wait after opening chat” to 50–100 ms.
game_injection_blocked_title: Sending was blocked by the system
game_injection_blocked_body: When Kotone sent the text, every simulated keypress was blocked by the system (0 got through). This isn't the target program's fault: right now even Notepad wouldn't receive it. Usually some software is blocking simulated input at the system level.
game_injection_blocked_security_software: (Tencent PC Manager, 360, Huorong, etc.): quit it, or add Kotone to its trusted list in its settings
game_injection_blocked_anticheat_hint: (e.g. Riot Vanguard): fully quit it from the taskbar tray, then try again
game_injection_blocked_remote_control_hi: (ToDesk, Sunlogin, etc.) with input protection: quit it, then try again
game_injection_blocked_quick_check: Quick check: open Notepad and try sending again. Quit suspicious programs one at a time and retry after each; once the text reaches Notepad, you've found the culprit.
auto_preview_only: The browser only previews the interface. Run automations in the desktop app.
auto_page_state_changed: The status has changed. Check the latest list.
auto_page_description: Reminders, key presses, mouse clicks, screen watching. Have {companion} write them, or save the ones you use often yourself. Scheduled ones run on their own when due.
auto_page_preview_notice: Interface preview: the data below is sample data and won't actually run.
auto_page_stop_hotkey_after: in the game to stop all automations and whatever she's doing (reminders aren't affected)
auto_page_stop_hotkey_unset: Stop hotkey not set (set it in Settings → System → Stop)
auto_page_history_hint: (Recently ended reminders and automations, with the reason for any failure, cancellation, or miss)
auto_list_run_countdown: Starting in {seconds} s. Switch to the game window.
auto_list_hint: ▶ runs, ■ stops. Ones with a schedule run on their own when due. If “Available to {companion}” is on, she can run it for you too.
auto_list_countdown_after: seconds in whatever window is in front (switch to the game)
auto_list_detail_program: Run a program (press keys, click the mouse, watch the screen)
auto_list_unscheduled: No schedule; run it yourself or have {companion} run it
auto_editor_param_required_hint: No default = required at run time
auto_editor_source_help: Available: key / key_down / key_up / type_text, click / mouse_move / mouse_down / mouse_up / scroll, wait / every / wait_until, brightness / color_at / find_color / find_image / find_text / ocr, say / toast / log, stop. In the program, parameters are
auto_editor_source_help_tail: . Coordinates are always window fractions from 0 to 1. See the docs for the full reference.
auto_editor_schedule_hint: (Like crontab: runs once each time it's due; runs missed while Kotone is closed aren't made up)
auto_editor_schedule_cron_placeholder: minute hour day month weekday, e.g. 30 21 * * 5
auto_param_region_hint: (Window fractions 0–1; a region picker is coming later)
auto_param_image_unset: Not set: she can take a screenshot to set it (a region picker is coming later)
auto_run_chat_sent: Sent to game chat for you
auto_run_chat_typed: Typed into the chat box (not sent)
misc_wake_state_waiting_runtime: Starts listening once local speech recognition starts
misc_wake_state_model_missing: Wake word model not downloaded yet
auto_editor_speak_placeholder: e.g. Time to drink water, or Time to \{text\}
auto_editor_speak_params_help: Write \{parameter name\} in the text and it's replaced with the value given at run time. Add a number parameter delay_seconds to make it “say this after a few seconds”.
